incidentList.summary: The target is returning HTTP 500 on consecutive runs, indicating a real outage on the service rather than a flaky selector or regional problem. Please review the service logs and recent changes to identify the server-side failure.

The synthetic runner cannot find a required module (specShim.js), causing the check to error out before contacting the site; this appears to be a monitoring/runtime deployment issue affecting collectors rather than a Wegmans outage. Investigate the runner/agent installation, recent deploys, and file paths/permissions on the collectors.

The check consistently fails because the expected 'Dinner' element never becomes visible even though the Meals & Recipes page loads. Update the monitor's selector or adjust the step to match the page's current DOM (the site appears up, not down).

The homepage loads but the monitor timed out waiting for the fulfillment element used to set carry-out Buffalo/McKinley; failures are consistent across locations and runs, pointing to a page/selector change (update the monitor's selector or workflow to match the new UI).

The browser check errored with a JS assertion ('toBeNull' on undefined) while adding the pizza. The site content renders but the element the test expects appears missing or altered (selector drift); inspect and update the monitor's selector/assertion or handle the dialog variant that appeared in the baseline screenshot.

The synthetic monitor process could not import /app/dist/checks/recipe-search.js, causing the check to error before contacting the target; this appears to be a monitoring build/deploy issue rather than the Wegmans site being down — verify the check artifact, build/packaging step, and recent deploys.
